findings.scope: Admission evidence is separate from real handler invocations and external failure destination delivery. Alias-qualified invocation ARNs identify the active case despite eventually consistent mapping workers.
findings.retry_identity: Repeated handler invocations can reuse context.aws_request_id. Distinct handler timestamps and native log events are retained; arrays are not deduplicated by request ID.
findings.partial_checkpoint: With ReportBatchItemFailures and retry1, [1,2,3,4] becomes suffix [2,3,4] and that suffix is invoked twice. Its destination approximateInvokeCount is2. Without reporting enabled, returned failure entries are ignored in the observed successful batch.
findings.bisection: Partial+bisect attempts: [1,2,3,4],[2,3,4],[2],[2],[3,4]. Raised-error+bisect attempts: [1,2,3,4],[1,2],[1],[2],[2],[3,4]. Failed singleton destination count is2; splitting does not consume the singleton retry allowance in these cases.
findings.window_flush: BatchSize2/window5 produced [1,2],[3,4],[5]; last singleton arrived4.992 seconds after second full batch by handler timestamps.
findings.tumbling: Observed window start/end UTC strings, state accumulation0→4, final invocation with Records:[] and isFinalInvokeForWindow:true, and state:{} at the next window. Both nonfinal and final events carried shardId,eventSourceARN,isWindowTerminatedEarly:false.
findings.source_permissions: Create without source permissions rejected. After explicit source deny, mapping stayed Enabled and Get LastProcessingResult reported actual DescribeStream explicit-deny failure; no invocation in the denied observation window. After policy restoration, queued ordinals1 and2 were delivered. Earlier Update success remains propagation-sensitive, not proof of bypass.
findings.maximum_age: Age60 record held70 seconds while Disabled produced no handler invocation and SQS RecordAgeExceeded. Native approximateInvokeCount is1 and responseContext is omitted entirely.
findings.malformed_partial: Empty itemIdentifier with reporting enabled/retry0 produced one invocation and a full-batch RetryAttemptsExhausted destination with functionError:null.
findings.qualified_identity: Different aliases of one function can have mappings to the same stream. Duplicate same alias+stream conflicts. List FunctionName matches exact qualification: unqualified function excluded existing alias mappings.
findings.tumbling_admission: PF>1 plus tumbling rejected; nonempty FilterCriteria plus tumbling rejected; empty Filters plus tumbling accepted and FilterCriteria omitted from response.
findings.latest: Only late sentinel ordinal2 was observed. Ordinal0 preceded Create; ordinal1 was written70 seconds after Enabled but was not observed during initialization. This is a bounded startup observation, not a promise of deterministic exclusion or polling latency.
findings.s3: See supplemental_runs[0]: real object bytes and ContentType application/octet-stream; key aws/lambda/<mapping UUID>/<shardId>/YYYY/MM/DD/YYYY-MM-DDTHH.MM.SS-<UUID>, no extension; payload is an escaped JSON string decoding to the original Records envelope.
